# Claude Code Hooks: Tool Events

These events fire before a tool runs, and when a permission is asked for or denied.
The events are `PreToolUse`, `PermissionRequest`, and `PermissionDenied`.
They are the main place to approve, change, or block a tool call.
For example, a `PreToolUse` hook on `Bash` can deny each command that holds `rm -rf`.
All three events match on tool name.
MCP tools are named `mcp__<server>__<tool>`.

## PreToolUse

| Mark | Item | What it does | How it works | Where it can be used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `PreToolUse` | Fires after Claude builds the tool input and before the tool runs | Matcher is the tool name. Exit 2 blocks and stderr is the reason. Does not fire for `@` file mentions | `command`, `http`, `mcp_tool`, `prompt`, `agent` | [Hooks Reference][hr], `PreToolUseHookInput` |
| ✅ | `tool_name` | Tool name | Any tool except `EndConversation` | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `tool_input` | The tool arguments | Shape by tool, see the next table. File paths are absolute | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `tool_use_id` | Tool call ID | A string | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `permissionDecision` | `allow`, `deny`, `ask`, `defer` | `allow` skips the prompt but not deny or ask rules. Order: `deny` > `defer` > `ask` > `allow`. `defer` works only in `-p` with one tool call | `hookSpecificOutput` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `permissionDecisionReason` | Reason text | `ask`: shown in the prompt. `deny`: shown to Claude. Others: debug log | `hookSpecificOutput` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `updatedInput` | Replaces the whole input | Rules and background checks use the new input. Needed with `allow` for `AskUserQuestion` and `ExitPlanMode`. Ignored with `defer` | `hookSpecificOutput` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `additionalContext` | Text next to the tool result | Ignored with `defer` | `hookSpecificOutput` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| 🔍 | `permissionDisplay` | Words for a permission card | An internal field for the desktop host only. Object `{title (200), description (2000), displayName (64)}`. Ignored with a debug line if a text cannot be shown | `hookSpecificOutput` | bundle |
| ⚠️ | Top-level `decision` and `reason` | Deprecated for this event | `approve` maps to `allow` and `block` maps to `deny`. The bundle schema accepts the enum on all events | stdout | [Hooks Reference][hr], bundle |
| ✅ | `ask` label | Prompt shows `[settings]`, `[plugin:<name>]`, or `[skill]` | An `ask` also forces a prompt in auto mode | Permission prompt | [Hooks Reference][hr] |

## Tool Input Shapes

| Mark | Item | What it does | How it works | Where it can be used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `Bash` | Run a command | `command`, `description`, `timeout` (ms), `run_in_background` | `tool_input` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `PowerShell` | Run a PowerShell command | Same keys as `Bash`. Match `Bash\|PowerShell` | `tool_input` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `Write` | Write a file | `file_path`, `content` | `tool_input` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `Edit` | Replace a string | `file_path`, `old_string`, `new_string`, `replace_all` | `tool_input` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `Read` | Read a file | `file_path`, `offset`, `limit` | `tool_input` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `Glob` | Find files | `pattern`, `path` | `tool_input` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `Grep` | Search content | `pattern`, `path`, `glob`, `output_mode`, `-i`, `multiline` | `tool_input` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `WebFetch` | Fetch a page | `url`, `prompt`, `offset` (2.1.290) | `tool_input` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `WebSearch` | Search the web | `query`, `allowed_domains`, `blocked_domains` | `tool_input` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `Agent` | Start a subagent | `prompt`, `description`, `subagent_type`, `model` | `tool_input` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `AskUserQuestion` | Ask 1 to 4 questions | `questions`, and `answers` (set only through `updatedInput`) | `tool_input` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `ExitPlanMode` | Ask to leave plan mode | Claude Code injects `plan` and `planFilePath` | `tool_input` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ❌ | `allowedPrompts` | Accepted and ignored | Used before 2.1.205 | `ExitPlanMode` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |

The docs name `Workflow` as a matchable tool and give no input shape for it.

## PermissionRequest

| Mark | Item | What it does | How it works | Where it can be used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `PermissionRequest` | Fires when a prompt would show, or when a call that cannot prompt would be denied | Matcher is the tool name. Exit 2 is not honored. No event for a sandbox network request. Use the `decision` object to deny | `command`, `http`, `mcp_tool`, `prompt` (an `agent` hook is skipped) | [Hooks Reference][hr], `PermissionRequestHookInput` |
| ✅ | `tool_name`, `tool_input` | Same as `PreToolUse` | No `tool_use_id` | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `permission_suggestions` | Updates that Claude Code suggests | The same shape as `updatedPermissions`. A dialog may show other options | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `decision.behavior` | `allow` or `deny` | Deny and ask rules still apply | `hookSpecificOutput` | [Hooks Reference][hr], `PermissionRequestDecision` |
| ✅ | `decision.updatedInput` | New tool input | `allow` only. Checked again against deny and ask rules | `hookSpecificOutput` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `decision.updatedPermissions` | Permission updates to apply | `allow` only | `hookSpecificOutput` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `decision.message` | Why it was denied | `deny` only. Goes to Claude | `hookSpecificOutput` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `decision.interrupt` | Stops Claude | `deny` only | `hookSpecificOutput` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |

## Permission Update Entries

| Mark | Item | What it does | How it works | Where it can be used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `addRules`, `replaceRules`, `removeRules` | Change rules | Fields `rules` (`{toolName, ruleContent?}`), `behavior` (`allow`, `deny`, `ask`), `destination` | `updatedPermissions`, `permission_suggestions` | [Hooks Reference][hr], `PermissionUpdate` |
| ✅ | `setMode` | Change the permission mode | `mode`: `default`, `auto`, `acceptEdits`, `dontAsk`, `bypassPermissions`, `plan`. `bypassPermissions` works only if bypass was on at launch | Same | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `addDirectories`, `removeDirectories` | Change working directories | Field `directories` | Same | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ⚠️ | `destination` | Where the change is kept | Docs: `session`, `localSettings`, `projectSettings`, `userSettings`. The d.ts also has `cliArg` | Same | [Hooks Reference][hr], `PermissionUpdateDestination` |

## PermissionDenied

| Mark | Item | What it does | How it works | Where it can be used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `PermissionDenied` | Fires only when auto mode denies a call, also with no classifier verdict | Matcher is the tool name. Not for manual denials, `PreToolUse` blocks, or deny rules. Exit code and stderr are ignored | All five types, but `prompt` and `agent` output is dropped | [Hooks Reference][hr], `PermissionDeniedHookInput` |
| ✅ | `tool_name`, `tool_input`, `tool_use_id`, `mcp_server` | As in `PreToolUse` | | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `reason` | Why auto mode denied | Rule name in brackets, such as `[Data Exfiltration]`. Other fixed texts are in the docs | stdin | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
| ✅ | `retry` | `true` tells the model it may retry | The denial stands. Ignored for no-verdict denials | `hookSpecificOutput` | [Hooks Reference][hr] |
